active_work_package.title: The documenting half of issue #78: ungated artifacts say so on their pages; the catalogue's charter-artifacts claim made precise; two stale schema-validation sentences corrected; two retired-prerequisite ledger actions closed
active_work_package.objective: Take from issue #78 only what documents the current state: mark Architect's three ungated artifacts on the page as Operate's and Plan's already are; make the catalogue's 'no page names the checkpoint or handoff' precise against the hub; correct the hub's and Plan's sentence that nothing validates a checkpoint, false since WP-035; retire NS-027 and NS-028, whose prerequisite WP-017 retired, and file the live half of NS-028 as an issue. Items 2 and 4 of #78 stay with a human.

stop_reason: WP-040 is done on this branch and awaits merge after fresh-context review. Of issue #78's four items, 1 and 3 are documented on the pages by this package; items 2 (owners for four artifacts) and 4 (homes for forty-one) are content decisions and NS-040 waits on a human for them. PR #74 (WP-036) is reviewed and held on issue #52: the operator's session instruction to proceed was relayed onto the issue by the agent, but a relayed chat instruction is not the operator's own record (DEC-002), and the tooling refused to let the agent treat it as merge authority - one line by the operator on issue #52 releases it. NS-027 and NS-028 are retired (DEC-042). Oracle authorship still requires an independent author; experiment re-run stays NOT_GRANTED.
known_divergence: The sixth instance of stale operational state (PR #56, which applied items 2 and 3 against this repository's own recorded ordering) is closed: #57 reverted it, and the fixtures are byte-identical to the sealed set at e37fa3b. A seventh opened at 2026-09-04T06:46:45Z and is closed by this commit: the human decision was recorded on issue #52, and until now this file still read resume_decision WAIT_FOR_AUTHORITY with a stop_reason naming the question that decision answers, while NS-031 - whose evidence requirement the decision had already met - remained the primary action. The interval was under four minutes because the decision record named the gap itself. That is not a fix for the underlying defect: state still reconciles by hand, and the proposal that would retire hand-maintenance remains PROPOSED on a failed instrument. WP-030 is stacked on WP-029's unmerged branch so that both can update this file without a merge conflict; if PR #58 merges with its branch deleted, GitHub retargets WP-030 to main. Until both merge, main's copy of this file still names WP-029 - that is the ordinary lag of a stacked change, not an eighth instance, because the record here says so. WP-030 merged as PR #64 after its stacked PR #60 was closed by the deletion of its base branch; the stacking rationale in DEC-028 (7) was wrong and is corrected by DEC-029 and this note - stack nothing on a branch that will be deleted. WP-031 merged as PR #65 at 28898879bef6, and the github-pages environment recorded a successful deployment of that head at 2026-09-04T15:46:34Z (deployment 6267852711). The README paragraph that said Pages was blocked and the site returned 404 was committed at 2026-09-03T12:56:32Z, five minutes after the first successful deployment (6244308440, success at 12:51:36Z), and stood until WP-032 - false when written, not merely outlived. It is replaced by pointers rather than by a fresher sentence; a fresher sentence would be the eighth instance waiting to happen. WP-032 merged as PR #67; the site's serving commit is read from the deployments API, not asserted here. WP-033 merged as PR #69 at 0b564b6. The WP-034 branch replaces the pre-dated deployment claims in LIVE_PREVIEW.md, NEXT_STEPS.md and AGENT_CONTINUITY.md by pointer and by dated correction, not by a fresher sentence. One correction to the WP-032 sentence above: the README paragraph and the runbook line were authored on 2026-09-02 while still true (cc40f0f), and merged to main five minutes after the first deployment succeeded - 'false when written' overstated it; they were false when merged and stood for a day. WP-034 merged as PR #70. From WP-035 on, a checkpoint that does not match its schema fails the test suite; the three that predate enforcement are registered by name and may only leave the registry. WP-036 is open as PR #74, held on the issue #52 answer, and registers NS-037 and DEC-038 on its own branch; this package branched from main without it, so whichever of the two merges second must merge badf/ against the other - DEC numbers, NS-033's wording and the decision-log order included. The spine registry emptied under WP-037. WP-037 merged as PR #75 at 7df92b6. The live badf hazard is now PR #74 (WP-036, held) against this package: #74 carries DEC-038 and NS-037, this carries DEC-040, NS-039 and NS-040; whichever lands second merges badf/ against the other. WP-038 merged as PR #79 at 0bbcda9. Against PR #74 the hazard on this branch is: #74 carries DEC-038 and NS-037 with NS-033 primary; this carries DEC-041, retires NS-039 and makes NS-040 primary with WAIT_FOR_AUTHORITY - whichever lands second must also reconcile the primary action and the resume decision. WP-039 merged as PR #80 at 0eab782. The hub and plan.html said nothing validates a checkpoint against its schema for a day after WP-035 made that false; corrected under WP-040 with the package named rather than a date, since the sentence is about a mechanism and not a status.
